title: Closed-Loop Benchmarking of Stereo Visual-Inertial SLAM Systems: Understanding the Impact of Drift and Latency on Tracking Accuracy
authors: Y. Zhao; J. S. Smith; S. H. Karumanchi; P. A. Vela
